title: Sheep reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sheep body - fluffy cream wool -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='15' fill='#F5F0DC'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='16' fill='#F5F0DC'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='15' fill='#F5F0DC'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='62' r='12' fill='#EDE8D0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='62' r='12' fill='#EDE8D0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='13' fill='#F5F0DC'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='44' r='11' fill='#EDE8D0'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='44' r='11' fill='#EDE8D0'/>
  <!-- Sheep head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#E8E0C8'/>
  <!-- Sheep face - darker wool/face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#D4CBB0'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='32' r='2' fill='#3D3D5C'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='32' r='2' fill='#3D3D5C'/>
  <circle cx='46.8' cy='31.2' r='0.7' fill='#B8B8E0'/>
  <circle cx='54.8' cy='31.2' r='0.7' fill='#B8B8E0'/>
  <!-- Nose/mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#C4A882'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='28' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#E0D8C0' transform='rotate(-20 36 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='28' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#E0D8C0' transform='rotate(20 64 28)'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='68' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#D4CBB0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='70' width='5' height='9' rx='2' fill='#D4CBB0'/>
  <rect x='54' y='70' width='5' height='9' rx='2' fill='#D4CBB0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='68' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#D4CBB0'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='36' y='76' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8B7D60'/>
  <rect x='46' y='77' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8B7D60'/>
  <rect x='54' y='77' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8B7D60'/>
  <rect x='60' y='76' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8B7D60'/>
  <!-- Book - open, held in front -->
  <!-- Left page -->
  <path d='M70 58 L70 78 L84 82 L84 62 Z' fill='#FFF8E8'/>
  <!-- Right page -->
  <path d='M84 62 L84 82 L98 78 L98 58 Z' fill='#FFFDF0'/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1='84' y1='62' x2='84' y2='82' stroke='#D4A020' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Book cover edges -->
  <path d='M70 58 L84 62 L98 58' stroke='#C8961E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M70 78 L84 82 L98 78' stroke='#C8961E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Text lines on left page -->
  <line x1='73' y1='63' x2='82' y2='66' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='73' y1='67' x2='82' y2='70' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='73' y1='71' x2='82' y2='74' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='73' y1='75' x2='82' y2='78' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Text lines on right page -->
  <line x1='86' y1='66' x2='95' y2='63' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='86' y1='70' x2='95' y2='67' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='86' y1='74' x2='95' y2='71' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='86' y1='78' x2='95' y2='75' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Bookmark ribbon -->
  <path d='M84 62 L84 70 L87 67 L90 70 L90 62' fill='#E04040'/>
  <!-- Hooves holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='60' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#D4CBB0'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='76' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#D4CBB0'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M47 40 Q50 42 53 40' stroke='#9B8B70' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>
</svg>
